scope: Isolated loopback-only fixture; not an application vulnerability assessment

coverage.detail: Passive response checks on 9 configured public GET routes at http://127.0.0.1:56329. Redirects are not followed. Login-protected pages, active XSS/injection tests, business logic, and external services were not tested.

conclusion: The installed ZAP active rule detects reflected XSS, but the current project passive baseline does not exercise that rule. These controls do not establish whether AIForce.Ops contains XSS.
